meta.data_note: Historical shot-level data from sportsdataverse nba_stats_shots. Zones are derived geometrically from shot x/y coordinates (not source labels): rim=shots within 8 ft of the hoop, short_mid=2pt shots 8-14 ft out, long_mid=2pt shots 14 ft+ out, corner_3=3pt shots with |x| >= 22 ft (corner region), atb_3=3pt shots above the break. League averages pool every shot from 2024-25. Zones below 50 attempts are excluded, never presented as skill. FG% is makes over attempts, not eFG. Documented estimates only; do not present as live or current-week.

zones.rim: shots within 8 ft of the hoop
